fusions.name: Level Blow
fusions.desc: A flattening blow that deals 15 damage, leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 6 seconds, stuns it for 1 second and leaves it [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Gravel Spray
fusions.desc: Sprays a cone of crushed reef that deals 3 damage to everything caught in it. Each hit has a 30% chance to leave the target [Hindered] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Packed Wall
fusions.desc: Packs the reef flat into a wall 5 tiles long for 8 seconds. Nothing crosses it, and anything that touches it is [Pinned] for 1 second.

fusions.name: Flattening Habit
fusions.desc: Each time you strike with your weapon, your physical damage rises by 30% for 5 seconds. Once every 12 seconds. You have 8% rock resistance.
